meta.network: in-process Hardhat network (chainId 31337, checked by run-one.cjs); nothing sent to any other network
meta.harness: benchmarking/privacy-eval (run-one.cjs, workload.cjs, observer.cjs, score.cjs, common.cjs) as of 2026-10-12, plus the opt-in PE_TRUTH_OUT dump in run-one.cjs (2026-10-17)

strategies.10: DAPP (the dApp's CASHOUT_POLICY: 10 USD after 5 notes, read from manager-frontend/src/utils/cashout.js)
strategies.other: DAPP:<D>:p5 (denominationUsd D, everyNotes 5; planning code of cashout.js unchanged)

fixed.float: default: (2 N/E + 20) x 20 USD per establishment in 3 deposits

rules.default: timing rule of the grid (20-slot window)
rules.batch: batch rule (next burst of each wallet, within windowMax 2000 slots)
rules.batchWide: batch rule with windowMax 20000 slots (N = 5000, D >= 500 only)

meta.best: the rule of default / window150 / batch with the highest mean recall over the seeds
meta.separation: ranges: 'above' when the lowest seed of the best rule exceeds the highest seed of the whole-run busiest-wallet guess; 'overlap' otherwise; pairedDiff: per seed, best rule minus that guess
meta.wait: first in, first out per establishment: a unit of revenue enters at the slot its order paid the establishment and leaves with the next withdrawal of that establishment; 1 slot = 12 s
meta.ranges: [minimum-maximum] of the seeds, not confidence intervals
